evidence: Extensive changes across src/wallet/spend.cpp, feebumper.cpp, coin selection, and walletdb to create and track BIP 352 transactions.
rationale: Adds wallet support for sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses across send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall. It brings substantial user value for on-chain privacy by integrating shared-secret coin selection, dynamic taproot output derivation, and fee-bumping persistence.
